description: This file defines the FilterExpression class in Twig, representing filter expressions in Twig's abstract syntax tree, including constructor logic, deprecation handling, and compilation method.

classes.name: FilterExpression
classes.description: Represents a filter expression node in Twig's AST, handling constructor logic, deprecation warnings, and compilation of filter nodes.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes a FilterExpression node, handling different filter input types, setting attributes, and issuing deprecation warnings.

methods.name: compile
methods.description: Compiles the filter expression into PHP code, handling special cases like 'raw' filter and setting the callable attribute.
